body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000806665

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
olf413 (Dmel, Q6NP60)
Tbh (Dmel, Q86B61)
CG5235 (Dmel, Q9VUY0)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous propagation
Tbh can catalyse the reaction dopamine->norepinephrine in vitro, however in vivo the physiological substrates is tyramine. Fly don’t have norepinephrine.
Annotation to remove:
GO:0042420	dopamine catabolic process
GO:0042421	norepinephrine biosynthetic process
GO:0004500	dopamine beta-monooxygenase activity
title: PAINT issue: erroneous propagation to Dmel genes PTN000806665
